# Christine Stuart & Gilbert Blythe

- [Christine Stuart](../character/christine-stuart.md) — Friend of — [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) — college friends · since v3  <sub>[v3 ch.Time P29](../source/v03-c41.md#nw-v03-c41-p0029)</sub>

## Shared scenes

> While preparing for the [Redmond](../codex/places.md#redmond-college) reception at Patty's Place, [Phil](../character/phil-gordon.md) tells [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) about [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) seen frequently with [Christine Stuart](../character/christine-stuart.md). [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) arrives at the reception with [Roy Gardner](../character/roy-gardner.md), feeling unusually off-kilter, and immediately notices [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) across the room with Christine.
>
> — v3 · Chapter XXVI Enter Christine

_Sources: [v3 ch.Christine P0](../source/v03-c26.md#nw-v03-c26-p0000), [v3 ch.Christine P12](../source/v03-c26.md#nw-v03-c26-p0012), [v3 ch.Christine P18](../source/v03-c26.md#nw-v03-c26-p0018)_

> As examinations finish and graduation arrives, the girls at Patty's Place reflect on what they have learned from their college experience. On [Convocation](../codex/places.md#convocation) day, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) chooses to wear Gilbert's flowers over Roy's. Later, after hearing a rumor of Gilbert's engagement to Christine, she breaks her pink heart chain in secret distress and refuses to dance with him at the graduation ball.
>
